items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: The interviewee discusses Arnold Licano's health but does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Papa Lane, who is only mentioned by the interviewer.

ctx.x: Oh here's what I started to tell you my train of thought. Mose Farrer F-E-R-R-E-R Farrer played piano with the Owls. When that piano player went up with them on a low account had a fallen out with Brown's band. They brought Mose Farrer up to play in Brown's band which I didn't know. It was a very short while but he did play with them in Chicago for about a month or six weeks. Mose was a pianist, his brother was a violinist and his mother was a professional music teacher. They lived sometime somewhere up around…
Well I think of it do you have any information on Arnold Licano? Last time I saw Papa Lane it's been three or four months now maybe. He said that Arnold Licano was so sick.

Well he's not to the point of dying but he has had a very severe ulcer which I fooled around with for about three or four years and I finally got him in the hands of a good internist who's treating him and he's better.
